design.name: Open Reference Lander R1
design.identity: Project-authored reference design; not Surveyor, VIPER, or built flight hardware.
design.geometry_source: The dimensions in this file define the reference design. They were not reconstructed from mission photographs.
design.body_frame: +X right, +Y forward, +Z up; metres; landing-plane origin
design.thermal_parameter_source: Explicit study assumptions, not measured hardware properties or vendor specifications.
design.boundary_source: Constant panel-plane sensitivity inputs, not site measurements, terrain-derived albedo, or certified environmental bounds. Added wall illumination may persist while the local Sun is terrain-blocked; no terrain-wall illumination model is asserted.
limitations: One temperature node and linear efficiency law; no battery, loads, wiring-string mismatch or heater controller.
Static pose with 64 panel samples and Sun/Earth center rays; no moving joints or disk-resolved structural occultation.
Uses the parent site's observer-height skyline for every component; no per-component terrain mask.
Earth result is geometric center LOS; antenna gain and RF link margin are unmodeled.
No physical test correlation, no uncertainty bounds, and no flight certification.

source.title: Surveyor VII Mission Report, Part I: Mission Description and Performance

transit.bcr_efficiency_evidence: Estimated in flight; not directly measured. Do not classify as measured calibration.

surface_operations.qualification: Generally ahead of Sun for charging control and equipment shade; fully sun-oriented only in the final 24 hours of the first lunar day. No per-epoch articulation history transcribed.

sunset.qualification: Camera sunlight loss and panel zero output are different observables. No historical terrain/pose replay has been validated.
